dct_description_sm: This dataset contains the location of forest floor transplants.  To create a healthy, sustainable forest we also need a healthy forest floor. A variety of plants that grow on the forest floor are transplanted into the older stands of trees. By increasing biodiversity in this way, the sustainability of the developing forests can be secured.  Updated annually.
